sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-torch.imatrix is a standard GGUF-format importance matrix (in_sum2 + counts per tensor), bit-compatible with llama-quantize --imatrix. Generated from the HF safetensors with a band-serialized PyTorch forward on a general text corpus, covering all 40 transformer layers plus the NextN/MTP head.
